fluff.overview: Conventional infantry within the Clan touman fills the garrison and screening roles that battle armor and BattleMech forces cannot efficiently sustain across dozens of occupied worlds. Mechanized Hover Points ride hovercraft that provide the fastest ground speed of any infantry transport, with the added capability of crossing water obstacles. This speed comes at the cost of durability, as hovercraft are fragile compared to tracked or wheeled vehicles, but in open terrain or coastal environments, few formations can match their ability to reposition quickly. Equipped with the Clan-manufactured Mauser IIC Infantry Assault System, these warriors carry energy weapons built to Clan standards that outperform their Inner Sphere equivalents in both range and damage output.
